constants.notes: Solar power P = 1361 * area * efficiency * cos(angle). Battery Wh = load_W * eclipse_h / depth_of_discharge.

solar_panels.name: Silicon solar panel
solar_panels.description: 1960s silicon cells, about 10% efficient. Zero output in eclipse.
solar_panels.source: Inspired by real Vanguard 1 (1958) and Telstar (1962) silicon solar cells.

batteries.name: Nickel-cadmium battery
batteries.description: Rechargeable and long-lived at shallow discharge.
batteries.source: Inspired by real nickel-cadmium cells used on early satellites, 1960s.

batteries.name: Silver-zinc battery
batteries.description: Light and powerful, but wears out with repeated cycles.
batteries.source: Inspired by real silver-zinc batteries used on 1960s spacecraft.

fuel_cells.name: Alkaline fuel cell
fuel_cells.description: High power without sunlight, but it consumes reactants that eventually run out. Makes drinking water for crew as a bonus.
fuel_cells.source: Inspired by the real Pratt & Whitney / General Electric fuel cells of Gemini and Apollo, 1960s.
